description: This file defines interfaces for converting event data to and from queue messages within the Orleans streaming framework, specifically for persistent streams. It includes methods for creating queue messages from stream events and for creating message batches from queue messages.

classes.name: IQueueDataAdapter<TQueueMessage>
classes.description: Interface for converting stream event data to queue messages.

classes.name: IQueueDataAdapter<TQueueMessage, TMessageBatch>
classes.description: Interface extending IQueueDataAdapter to include batch creation from queue messages.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a queue message from stream event data.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a message batch from a queue message.
